title: AntennaPod Unplayed Queue Growth
app: Jellyfin, Emby, Steam, Steam Deck logs, Xbox and Nintendo exports, Tautulli, AntennaPod, RetroArch, and the *arr stack via official APIs, local databases, webhook payloads, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=antennapod:episode
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count(eval(state="unplayed")) as unplayed_episodes by podcast _time
| streamstats current=f avg(unplayed_episodes) as baseline_unplayed by podcast
| where baseline_unplayed>0 AND unplayed_episodes>baseline_unplayed*1.5
| sort - unplayed_episodes
description: Uses AntennaPod episode exports telemetry to monitor backlog growth in unplayed podcast episodes in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for shows that are piling up faster than listening time allows, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest AntennaPod episode exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors backlog growth in unplayed podcast episodes so you can spot shows that are piling up faster than listening time allows before it becomes annoying.
